mapper.insert: insert into user_coupon(user_id, coupon_id, status, receive_time, use_time, expire_time) values (#{userId}, #{couponId}, #{status}, now(), #{useTime}, #{expireTime})
mapper.select: select id, user_id, coupon_id, status, receive_time, use_time, expire_time from user_coupon where user_id = #{userId} order by receive_time desc
